title: 第23章 谈第24章 灵根
content_zh:
凌晨一点。
完成了保安工作的张羽正一路挤地铁坐公交，回到自己郊区的出租房去。
至于为什么凌晨一点的公交地铁还是人挤人，自然是因为凌晨一点属于嵩阳市的夜班晚高峰，多得是上下班的人出来挤。
回到家里先洗了个澡，张羽看了看账户里余额，心里想着是不是能买个空调了。
毕竟8300的存款，让他一下子感觉到本月的生活充裕了许多。
不过想到两周后就是下个月了，到时候又要还15000的贷款，他就忍不住皱了皱眉头。
回想起白真真说的话。
他心中喃喃道“学校的合同吗？”
如果签了合同能每月给他一大笔钱，那倒是不用担心贷款的事情了。
不过张羽也知道多想无益，不论是这次天人演武图前的表现也好，还是学校的合同也好，一切的根本终究还是在于他自己的天赋和实力。
想到这里，他已经拿出了今天在校门口文具店买的神经填充剂服下。
接着他便盘膝坐在床上，开始运转周天采气法，感受着天地间的一缕缕灵机涌入体内。
虽然今天为了天人演武图的考验，他将羽书的专精切换成了天武炼心诀，周天采气法要等到24小时后切换回来，才能继续快速提升。
但反正天武炼心诀他道心尚未3级也练不成，接下来又要为法赛做准备来提升法力。
周天采气法虽然今天暂时无法快速提升，但已经达到4级的周天采气法本身就能帮他有效提高法力。
于是接下来这一夜的时间，便在张羽的默默吐纳中过去。
……
第二天一大早。
张羽一进教室就发现了和平时不太一样的地方。
正常来讲，在嵩阳高中里的绝大部分学生，每日都专注于自身的学习和修炼，是不太会关心班里其他普通学生的。

即使是同班同学的两个人，也可能几个月都说不上一句话。
就像是张羽每天进教室的时候根本没谁会关注他。
也就只有赵天行这样的，才会在每天进教室的时候想着同学们是不是在看他。
但今天不一样，张羽能够明显感觉到，就在他进入教室以后，不时就有同学偷偷打量着他。
而张羽一坐下，周天翊就拍了拍他的肩膀，说道“你被金丹真人收徒的事情在班里传开了。”
“好像是和钱深一起去画展那几个人在群里说的。”
众所周知，学校是这个世界上小道消息流传最快的地方之一。
而嵩阳高中作为重点高中，修炼压力大，绝育青年多，手机人人有，这小道消息的传播速度也就更快了。
别说文字消息，就连昨天张羽穿着保安服的照片都已经在群里传开了。
张羽闻言呵呵一笑。
“班里开始传我的事迹了吗？不愧是嵩阳速度，那就继续传吧。”
content_en:
One o'clock in the morning.
After finishing his security work, Zhang Yuzheng squeezed the subway and took the bus all the way back to his rental house in the suburbs.
As for why the buses and subways are still crowded at 1 a.m., it’s naturally because 1 a.m. is the peak night shift period in Songyang City, and there are so many people commuting to get off work.
After returning home and taking a shower, Zhang Yu looked at the balance in his account and wondered if he could buy an air conditioner.
After all, the 8,300 deposit made him feel that his life was much richer this month.
However, he couldn't help but frown when he thought that next month would be two weeks later and he would have to repay a loan of 15,000 yuan.
Recall what Bai Zhenzhen said.
He murmured in his mind, "The school's contract?"
If signing a contract can give him a large amount of money every month, then there is no need to worry about loans.
However, Zhang Yu also knew that it was useless to think too much. Whether it was his performance before this Tianren Wutu performance or the school's contract, the root of everything ultimately lay in his own talent and strength.
Thinking of this, he had already taken out the nerve filler he bought at the stationery store at the school gate today and drank it.
Then he sat cross-legged on the bed and began to use the Zhoutian Qi Collection Technique, feeling the wisps of spiritual energy from heaven and earth pouring into his body.
Although today, for the test of Tianren Martial Arts, he switched Yu Shu's specialization to Tianwu Heart Refining Technique, the Zhoutian Qi Gathering Technique will have to wait until he switches back after 24 hours before he can continue to improve rapidly.
But anyway, he can't practice the Tianwu Heart Refining Technique since he has not yet reached level 3 of Dao Xin. Next, he has to prepare for the magic competition to increase his magic power.
Although the Zhoutian Qi Gathering Technique cannot be improved quickly today, the Zhoutian Qi Gathering Technique itself, which has reached level 4, can help him effectively increase his mana.
So the rest of the night passed in Zhang Yu's silence.
…
Early the next morning.
As soon as Zhang Yu entered the classroom, he noticed something different from usual.
Normally, most of the students in Songyang High School focus on their own study and cultivation every day and don't care much about other ordinary students in the class.
Even two people who are in the same class may not speak to each other for months.
It's like no one pays attention to Zhang Yu when he enters the classroom every day.
Only Zhao Tianxing would think about whether his classmates were looking at him when he entered the classroom every day.
But today was different. Zhang Yu could clearly feel that right after he entered the classroom, classmates were secretly looking at him from time to time.
As soon as Zhang Yu sat down, Zhou Tianyi patted him on the shoulder and said, "It has spread in the class that you were accepted as a disciple by Master Jin Dan."
"It seems that the people who went to the art exhibition with Qian Shen said it in the group."
As we all know, school is one of the places in the world where gossip spreads fastest.
As a key high school, Songyang High School has high pressure for cultivation, many young people are sterilized, and everyone has a mobile phone, so this gossip spreads faster.
Not to mention text messages, even the photo of Zhang Yu wearing security uniform yesterday has been circulated in the group.
Zhang Yu laughed when he heard this.
"Have the class started spreading the word about my deeds? As expected of Songyang, let's continue spreading the word."
